name: Effective Range / Positive Recursive Teaching Dimension
proof: Repeatedly remove an inclusion-maximal concept. Its positive labels on all active coordinates distinguish it from every remaining concept: no remaining concept can contain it, and each differs on a positive coordinate. These samples have size at most \(\mathrm E(\mathcal H)\), yielding a positive recursive teaching sequence with that bound.
witness_verification: For the family #classes/singletons with n>=4, the established endpoint values or bounds, in parameter order, are $n$ and $1$. The first parameter divided by one plus the second tends to infinity as n tends to infinity, ruling out every reverse affine-linear bound. See the database-owned value proofs for these two endpoints.
